about_the_game:
Infinite Pathways is an abstract puzzle game with a difficult variety throughout multiple game modes, in where the main part is your mood while playing, since you chose

what to play and which win condition you like the most.

Play as a cube with the ability to rotate on itself, take advantage of this an interact with the terrain with each face,

as you may realise this mechanics are too easy to learn, but be sure that the game is nothing like that. Match the upper face of the cube with the cells on the floor,

be aware that, you'll have to learn to move in specific sequences, sometimes time won't matter but movement will.

Lineal or simple puzzles?

Two experiences completely different, on one side you'll get the chance to play a campaing mode where you'll explore oneiric surroundings to unfold the true

and escape this dreamlike paradise; with progression like; narrative and a variety of mechanics outside the game boards; and on the other side a more simple straightfoward gameplay mode, overcome different game modes, from time trial, going on a more zen experience, to an overwhelming difficult without much time to spare.

The adventure mode unleash a bunch of options, not limiting the player to play inside grids or cells. An entire open world is your gigant puzzle, that you'll need to solve!

Every little step will require you to think outside the box, nonetheless, your journey seeks to be a more intimate experience, allowing you to enjoy the world and think of

the philosophy behind this dreamlike world.

The rules change a little in each game mode, transforming the experience into a whole new thing, for a game with mechanics so simple as moving a cube.

Classic: Take all the cells before the time runs out.

Time trial: In just one minute you'll have to take the cells before it escapes

Zen: Forget about time, relax and enjoy, have you check the music box on the menu option?

Chezz: Time is not a problem, there are only two cells, when you consume one, the other dissapears and a new chained-pair appear.

Don't move so fast! Think carefully before each movement, you'll have limit steps, even though each cell will restore some steps, but not all!

Puzzle: More limit steps! In order to solve this you'll have to understand which paths to take.

Dynamic grid: Consume cells will destroy the grid. Let's see how much you can endure before running out of moves.

Submode Hardcore

A hardcore mode is available, for those who want a harder challenge, activate it to apply a new option to all these modes. Will you be able to win them?

Chose a skin of your liking to set at all time, a bunch unlocked from the very beginning, others hidden in challenges for you to uncover.
